name: fill_selected_buffer_entries

name: build_per_row_value_table
description: Fills 176 row entries of both buffers, each with a pointer word and fixed words taken from a table chosen by a mode byte, then writes a final pair of words.

name: fade_palette_one_step
description: Repeats sixteen times: reduces each colour word by one step in every 4-bit component, saturating at zero, and applies the same reduction to the buffer entries. It waits for a frame flag between passes.

description: Zeroes two large work buffers and a smaller table by writing zero words through a loop.

description: Calls one unnamed routine, which touches the DMA control register, then spins forever in an endless loop.

name: write_fixed_entries_both_buffers
description: Writes a fixed set of sixteen-bit values into the same offsets of both buffers, with one final entry taken from a stored variable.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:C976
name: write_default_entries_both_buffers
description: Writes a fixed set of default values, mostly zero and one constant, into the same offsets of both buffers.

name: setup_display_tables_and_registers
description: Builds a 256-entry table of bit-reversed bytes, allocates the working tables with their sizes, and fills the row-offset table. It then writes the display control and copper list entries for both buffers and sets the display window, fetch and bitplane modulo registers and the DMA and interrupt enables.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:DBE8
name: lookup_range_table_value
description: Scans a table of three-value records and returns the first value of the record whose range contains the argument, or a default of 1000 when none matches.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:DC6A
name: map_type_to_record_value
description: Maps a record's type code through a set of fixed pairs to a value stored in one record field. For a listed set of type codes it also sets a flag bit in another field.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:DDBC
name: sum_scaled_range_values
description: For the range entry matching the key, adds up a scaled value for each index in that range using two lookup tables, and returns twice the total.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:DECA
name: mark_range_indices_as_set
description: For the range entry matching the key, sets a flag word to one for every index in that range.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:DF66
name: select_active_entries_within_budget
description: Marks the present entries of a 46-byte table and sums a per-entry cost for them. Entries that push the total past a fixed budget are cleared, then a 300-word area is cleared and the selected entries are drawn through an unnamed routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E188
name: start_state_three_with_speed
description: Starts state three with a timer of 100 and a second timer of 200, and sets a fixed negative offset. It sets a horizontal speed from the argument, reversed when the position lies left of the second argument, and sets a value of 5.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E1DC
name: check_record_contact_and_clear
description: When the timers are zero, checks whether the record overlaps the main sprite's extent using a height chosen by the current state. On overlap it clears the record's type, sets a value and calls an unnamed routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E27C
name: advance_active_slot_positions
description: For each of three active slots, moves its position by the stored speed and counts frames of slow movement. It refreshes the slot's table pointer and clears the slot when an unnamed check fails, otherwise it calls an unnamed routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E33E
name: check_free_slot_available
description: Returns 1 when one of the three slots in the small table has a zero first word, meaning it is free, and 0 when all are in use.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E352
name: find_next_free_slot_pointer
description: Steps through twelve-byte slots starting after the current one until it finds one whose first word is zero. It returns 1 if one is found and 0 if none remain.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E362
name: initialise_slot_from_source_record
description: Fills a three-slot record with a type code from the source's table, a vertical position, a horizontal position and a speed whose direction faces the main sprite. It then sets the state to 4.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E3B0
name: initialise_slot_type_and_position
description: Stores a type code made from the low bits of the argument minus 29, with the given position, clears the speed and sets a counter to one.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E3CE
name: set_speed_from_record_field
description: Sets a record's horizontal speed from one of its stored bytes, negated when the given x position lies left of the main sprite.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E3E6
name: offset_position_by_speed_sign
description: Returns the given x position moved sixteen units against the sign of the record's speed field.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E3F8
name: orient_speed_relative_to_limit
description: Makes a record's speed magnitude positive, then negates it when the position lies below a stored limit.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E412
name: update_record_behaviour_mode
description: Updates one record according to its mode. A patrol mode reverses direction at the edge of its range, a second mode sets a fixed vertical speed and steps its type code, and a third queues the record in a pending list when its counter runs out.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E44A
name: update_record_motion_toward_sprite
description: Updates a record's motion for its current mode, including a horizontal direction towards the main sprite, a countdown delay and a timed step. It returns a computed position value.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E476
name: update_record_facing_and_arm
description: Sets the record's facing from its horizontal position relative to the main sprite, then counts a timer down. When the sprite is within a set distance on both axes it arms the record and calls an unnamed routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E4BC
name: arm_timer_when_sprite_near
description: When the record lies left of the main sprite and within its range, sets a timer to thirty and calls an unnamed routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E4EA
name: tick_record_timer_and_count
description: Decrements a record's timer and, when a flag is set, advances a counter and calls unnamed routines before clearing the timer.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E510
name: update_record_chase_phases
description: Runs a phased chase routine for a record. When idle it starts a chase once the main sprite is in range, while chasing it reverses at set points, and in its other mode it sets a fixed vertical speed and steps its type code.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E556
name: start_pursuit_when_in_range
description: When the record is moving forward and within a fixed range of a reference position, it increments a counter, works out a negative step count from the argument, resets two fields and calls an unnamed routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E59C
name: step_record_phase_motion
description: Advances a record through two motion phases. In phase one it counts steps and reverses direction at a set point, and in phase two it advances a counter and calls unnamed routines when a position is reached.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E5EE
name: finish_phase_two_when_reached
description: In phase two of a record's motion, advances a counter and, once the counter reaches the stored position, resets the phase and calls two unnamed routines.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E61E
name: update_record_bounce_phases
description: Updates a record's bounce sequence. While active it starts a phase when the record is within horizontal distance of the main sprite, using a direction of plus or minus two, then reverses at the far point and steps the type code otherwise.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E66E
name: reverse_speed_at_phase_limit
description: When the argument is one, reverses the record's speed once it moves beyond a stored limit from its target and advances its phase. Otherwise, when the record reaches its target, it calls two unnamed routines and resets the phase.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E696
name: reset_phase_at_target
description: When the record reaches its stored target position, calls two unnamed routines and resets its phase to zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E6AE
name: run_record_phase_controller
description: Runs the main behaviour routine for a record and returns a value from it. It selects a phase by its phase value, covering idle detection, a timed approach toward the main sprite, a proximity check and a sprite contact check, and in its special state it sets a fixed vertical speed and steps through type codes.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E704
name: advance_record_phase_on_contact
description: Updates a record's phase without returning a value. It counts an idle timer up to eight, starts a timed approach toward the main sprite, and changes phase when the sprite is within set distances.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E732
name: reverse_speed_and_check_sprite
description: Reverses the record's horizontal speed on a set flag and checks its horizontal distance from the main sprite. It sets the phase to two when the sprite is out of range, and sets it to three when a phase-one record is within both distance limits.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E796
name: enter_phase_three_when_close
description: When the record is in phase one and close to the main sprite both horizontally and vertically, sets the phase to three and calls an unnamed routine.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E7D4
name: dispatch_record_phase_by_mode
description: Selects a phase from its argument. Mode two clears the phase and calls an unnamed routine when the record is away from a reference point, mode three runs the approach and timed move logic, and any other value sets the phase to one.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E81C
name: run_approach_phase_mode_three
description: When its argument is three, counts an idle timer, starts a timed move toward the main sprite once within range, and changes phase on a distance test. Any other argument sets the phase to one.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E834
name: run_record_detection_and_approach
description: Runs a record's detection and approach routine. When idle it starts a phase once the main sprite is within horizontal and vertical range, in the next phase it counts a timer and steps toward the sprite, and otherwise it cycles the type code or queues the record.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E888
name: update_record_phase_by_argument
description: When its argument is one, counts an idle timer, flips the record's speed on a flag and sets the phase to two when the sprite is out of horizontal range. Otherwise it checks the distance to a stored point, resets the phase, and calls an unnamed routine when the point is out of range.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E8B4
name: flip_speed_enter_phase_two
description: Clears a counter, flips the record's speed on a flag, and sets the phase to two when the record is more than 640 units away horizontally from the main sprite.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E904
name: reset_phase_away_from_point
description: Resets the record's phase and calls an unnamed routine when the record lies outside a fixed box around a stored point. Otherwise it returns unchanged.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E946
name: run_record_phase_with_distance
description: Runs a record's phase logic and returns a distance-based value. Idle detection starts an approach, the later phases count a timer and turn the record around at range, and a flagged record with a fixed speed is stepped through its type codes.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E996
name: step_record_phase_by_mode
description: Runs the phase logic for the record's current mode. Mode one counts a motion that turns the record around at range, mode two is a proximity test that returns the record to idle, and other modes step a fixed-speed type-code sequence when a flag is clear.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:E9D6
name: flip_speed_far_from_sprite
description: Flips the record's speed on a flag and sets its phase to two when it lies more than 640 units horizontally from the main sprite after the flip.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:EA2A
name: check_proximity_start_phase_one
description: When its argument is two, returns the record to idle if it lies outside a fixed box around a stored point. Otherwise it steps a timer and sets the phase to one, unless the record is already in a flagged state.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:EA72
name: start_phase_one_from_timer
description: Subtracts two from a stored counter and returns the result of an unnamed routine when the record has a flag set. When that flag is clear it sets the phase to one directly, and otherwise returns zero.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:EA8E
name: subtract_two_enter_phase_one
description: Subtracts two from a stored counter, sets the phase to one and calls unnamed routines.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:EAA6
name: run_record_approach_controller
description: Runs the approach controller for a record. While idle it starts an approach when the main sprite is within horizontal and vertical range and no other record is busy, later phases follow the sprite and return to idle when it moves away, and otherwise the type code is cycled and the record is queued.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:EAFE
name: update_record_approach_by_mode
description: Updates a record's approach for its argument. Mode one starts a follow phase when the sprite is in range and returns to idle when it moves away, mode two sets phase three when the record is far horizontally, and any other argument returns to idle when the record is away from its stored point.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:EB42
name: reset_phase_to_idle
description: Calls an unnamed routine and sets the record's phase back to idle.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:EB4C
name: update_phase_two_or_point
description: When its argument is two, flips the record's speed on a flag and sets phase three when the record is far from the sprite. Otherwise it checks the distance to a stored point and returns to idle when the record is out of range.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:EBA6
name: reset_phase_outside_stored_box
description: Returns unchanged when the record lies within a fixed box around a stored point. Otherwise it calls two unnamed routines and resets its phase to idle.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:EBEC
name: run_record_detection_and_chase
description: Runs a record's detection and chase controller and returns a distance-based value. Idle detection starts a phase when the sprite is near, a later phase counts a timer and reverses the record, and a further phase steps toward the sprite and returns to idle when the sprite is out of reach.

key: titus the fox - to marrakech and back (1992)(titus)[cr nemesis][t +3 atx]/Titus the Fox - To Marrakech and Back (1992)(Titus)[cr Nemesis][t +3 ATX].adf:main:3:EC3C
name: reset_phase_to_idle
description: Gap code that matches the phase reset routine: it calls an unnamed routine and sets the phase to idle.
